description: Use this when the user asks what an Employer of Record provider charges per employee, about set-up fees, deposits, exchange margins, termination or benefit fees, or how providers' fees compare (e.g. "EOR setup fees and deposits", "does this provider ask for a deposit?", "frais d'un EOR par salarié et par mois"). EOR Scope does not republish provider fees, so this gives no amount: for each type of fee (monthly fee, set-up, deposit, currency exchange, termination, benefits), the questions to ask a provider, and for each provider tracked by eorscope.com, in alphabetical order and unranked, the address of its official fee page (its quote page when it quotes on request only) with the date EOR Scope last read it, and its page on eorscope.com. Once the user has a figure, pass it to employer_cost (full cost with the fees entered) or reconcile_quote (a quote line by line). Data snapshot 2026-11-06. Cost comparison, not legal or tax advice.
name: eor_fee_sources
title: Where Employer of Record providers publish their fees
